annotation.interpretation_a: The host may discard any pending data and prevent the application from reading any data after CLOSE.
annotation.interpretation_b: The host may only prevent reading of new data after CLOSE, while still allowing the application to read data that was queued before CLOSE.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether pending data is discarded or still readable, allowing two materially different implementation behaviours.
